items.name: Glimmer-Arrow Pendant
items.lore: A glimmer-glass arrowhead. It points toward the Glimmer King's hosts, wherever they are.

items.name: Elfshot Ward
items.lore: A healer's charm against the glimmer folk's arrows.

items.name: Madman's Bracer
items.lore: An elfshot man made this, in his madness. It's very good.

items.name: Glimmerling Cloak
items.lore: It catches the light and throws it back wrong.

items.name: Subverter's Glass Ring
items.lore: A ring of glimmer-glass, taken from a raging subverter's hand. It hums, faintly.

items.name: Healer's Knotted Belt
items.lore: Every knot a patient. Bebhinn ran out of rope.

items.name: Four-Note Torc
items.lore: Ceallach strung a bead for every note of the King's call, and broke the last one.

items.name: Counter-Song Charm
items.lore: A druid's charm, sung over. It hums a fifth note, out of tune with the four.

items.name: Lurikeen Hearth-Charm
items.lore: A little clay figure of a hearth, made by lurikeen children.

items.name: Cleanser's Torc
items.lore: An Azure cleanser's torc. Every link has a name scratched into it - the names of the cleansed.

items.name: Pale Horse Bracer
items.lore: Leather from a pale horse of the hills. It never quite warms.

items.name: Exile's Cloak
items.lore: Grey and patched. Cnoc wore it for a year.

items.name: Inquisitor's Ring
items.lore: Taken from the Azure inquisitor who held the village.

items.name: Pale Pasture Halter-Ring
items.lore: From a pale horse's halter. Lurikeen-sized.

items.name: Pen-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: The pen's bar, beaten into a bracer by a grateful smith.

items.name: Doubter's Blue Torc
items.lore: Ailill's own torc, the crown crossed out. He gave it up.

items.name: Pitch-Cart Belt
items.lore: Leather from the Inquisitor's pitch-carts. Smells of smoke.

items.name: Dsaldor's Enamel Bracer
items.lore: Blue enamel, the crown crossed out. Dsaldor's own.

items.name: Coseal's Censer Ring
items.lore: A tiny censer on a ring. It still smokes, faintly.

items.name: Thror's Pyre-Cloak
items.lore: Singed at the hem from a hundred pyres.

items.name: Lord Orist's Glass Belt
items.lore: It throws the light back wrong, like all their glass.

items.name: Mianed's Upland Ring
items.lore: Cold, and very bright.

items.name: Kelegur's Shining Torc
items.lore: It shines whether there's light or not.

items.name: Zeit's Griever Bracer
items.lore: Made from a griever's shell. It moans in the wind.

items.name: Meldun's Muster-Roll Ring
items.lore: A ring with a list engraved inside it. Every name crossed out.

items.name: Arios's Lamp-Glass Charm
items.lore: A sliver of a Glimmer lamp. It still remembers being lit.

items.name: Xaquira's Light-Woven Belt
items.lore: Woven, somehow, out of light. It is warm.

items.name: Venlar's Gate-Key Torc
items.lore: A key of light, bent into a torc. It opens nothing now.

items.name: Mantle of the Ceannai Sentinels
items.lore: The Sentinels' own, for those who broke the King's guard.

items.name: Lord-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Ten lords. Ten notches.

items.name: Zanllvi's Sealing-Wax Ring
items.lore: The wax on it is gold, and still soft.

items.name: Answer-Bearer's Belt
items.lore: The courier's belt. It carried the King's answer as far as the hollow.

items.name: Saumer's Ring-Stone Charm
items.lore: A chip from the ring of stones. It is warm, and very old.

items.name: Lightbreaker's Bracer
items.lore: For the one who broke the last of the King's lords.

items.name: Mantle of the King's Answer
items.lore: Aine's Circle's own, for the one who read the King's answer and knew what to do with it.

items.name: Unlit Lantern Torc
items.lore: A Glimmer lamp, put out for good, bound in silver.

items.name: Ring of the Broken Bargain
items.lore: Two seals - a crowned woman, a crowned man - cut in half and set together.
